integrity: The proof reduces exactly to five cyclic twin-class occupancies and exhausts all profiles of size at most five; finite explicit-graph experiments are corroboration only. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary one-level Mycielskian of K_{m,n}, m,n>=5, enumerating minimum swap-secure dominating sets only. Not a generalized Mycielskian, not all secure sets. A relevant 2022 publisher article was not fully inspected; broader historical priority and independent mathematical verification remain open.
title: Complete census of minimum secure dominating sets in Mycielski bicliques
